title: Return to Ravnica: card flavor text

entities.name: Nefara
entities.description: A Dimir agent who watched an armory guard from the shadows.

entities.name: Arrester Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius arrester of the Tenth Precinct.

entities.name: Agmand Sarv
entities.description: An Azorius hussar who values society over the few.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros angel who says conviction matters more than righteousness.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Dryad leader of the Selesnya Conclave who serves the Worldsoul.

entities.name: Prime Izmagnus
entities.description: An Izzet author of a journal of time reversal experiments.

entities.name: Andalum
entities.description: A man content after losing his memories.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Golgari lich lord who fancies himself king of the undercity.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A speaker who mocks Boros noise.

entities.name: Magistrate Ludy
entities.description: A magistrate who designated land for brushstriders.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: An Orzhov leader speaking to Isperia.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Lord of the Rakdos cult who woke from slumber.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds vie for power.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The Selesnya's unifying spirit that Trostani serves.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius city and seat of airspace restrictions.

entities.name: Battle of Sumala
entities.description: A battle where four Selesnya sentries held off a Gruul clan.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild of spies and sleeper agents.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild of law, order and arrests.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of nature and unity led by Trostani.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild of mages and experimentation led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The guild of contracts and souls.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild of rot and the undercity, also called the Swarm.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: The guild of soldiers, with garrisons.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: The guild that released an ooze in a district.

entities.name: Hauler's Collective
entities.description: A merchant guild of influence over Ravnican merchants.

events.summary: Dimir agents watched an armory guard for eight hours and Nefara suggested another way in.
events.quote: Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink,

events.summary: Rakdos stirred from slumber and everyone else's nightmare began.
events.quote: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

events.summary: Teysa warns Isperia that the Selesnya are gathering armies.
Trostani decreed that no one should travel alone after bleak rumors.
events.quote: She decreed that no one should travel alone.

events.summary: Four Selesnya sentries held off an entire Gruul clan at the Battle of Sumala.
events.quote: four Selesnya sentries held off an entire clan of Gruul warriors.

events.summary: Selesnya missionaries in the Shanav Quarter faced scorn and martyrdom.
events.quote: they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

events.summary: Cryptwitch Merree vanished after a spat with Rakdos.
events.quote: Cryptwitch Merree vanished after a spat with Rakdos

events.summary: Joining the Worldsoul took years, severed by the snap of Rakdos's fingers.
events.quote: Severing that connection took the snap of Rakdos's fingers.

events.summary: A sphinx warns Isperia of danger on the horizon.
Leonos left skyrunes warning of an eviction.
events.quote: He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction

relations.note: Trostani serves the Worldsoul and leads the Conclave.
relations.quote: We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness.
Obviously, the Firemind's mission is worth more than a few goblins.

relations.note: Isperia is Supreme Judge of the Azorius.

relations.quote: The good of society matters much more than the inconvenience of a few.

relations.note: Teysa suspects Selesnya of war preparations.
relations.quote: Do you still believe they aren't preparing for war?

relations.note: Dryads defend the Worldsoul from Izzet progress.
relations.quote: We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost.
